name: quack
notes: quack_check_token compares its second and third VARCHAR arguments with a timing-safe equality (QuackAuthToken, src/quack_extension.cpp) and quack_nop_authorization returns its second argument unchanged (QuackDummyAuthorization). Both are the registered default authentication/authorization callbacks of the Quack server, but calling them reads or changes no server state: they are pure functions of their arguments. quack_uri_parser parses its VARCHAR argument into a STRUCT (QuackParseUriFunction).

The callbacks the server actually invokes are selected by the quack_authentication_function and quack_authorization_function settings, which validated SQL cannot change (SET is unsupported and current_setting is elevated).
